gene_region_annotation.statement: The structural variant is located within the coordinates of the SNTG2 gene (ENSG00000172554) on chromosome 2.
Ensembl VEP predicts that the insertion is an intronic variant (intron 1/16) on the canonical SNTG2 transcript ENST00000308624 with a MODIFIER impact.
Ensembl VEP predicts intronic MODIFIER consequences for the insertion across multiple non-canonical SNTG2 transcripts, including some annotated with nonsense-mediated decay.
The insertion breakpoint resides within a repeating genomic region annotated with tandem repeats of type 'trf'.

population_evidence.statement: Seven dbVar database entries (esv3656833, nsv3953858, nsv5618433, nsv5961524, nsv6053736, nsv6220675, nsv7862737) represent exact coordinate and type matches for an insertion variant at chromosome 2 coordinate 983,265.

clinical_phenotype_evidence.statement: The matching and nearby dbVar records do not supply clinical significance findings for this insertion variant.
Quality control evaluations indicate a repeat region is present at the breakpoints (6 start and 6 end repeat counts), which can make structural variant breakpoint placement less reliable.

possible_interpretations.statement: A causal connection cannot be established between this specific intronic insertion and SNTG2-associated neurodevelopmental, autism, or psychiatric phenotypes based solely on general gene-level literature and coordinate overlap.

limitations: Baseline Ensembl evidence is coordinate-overlap evidence.

verified_claims.text: The structural variant is located within the coordinates of the SNTG2 gene (ENSG00000172554) on chromosome 2.
verified_claims.notes: Verified against baseline Ensembl records; the variant coordinates on chromosome 2 are within the SNTG2 genomic interval (950816 to 1367613).

verified_claims.text: Ensembl VEP predicts that the insertion is an intronic variant (intron 1/16) on the canonical SNTG2 transcript ENST00000308624 with a MODIFIER impact.
verified_claims.notes: VEP-BL-001 confirms ENST00000308624 is the canonical transcript, the consequence is intron_variant (intron 1/16), and the impact is MODIFIER.

verified_claims.text: Ensembl VEP predicts intronic MODIFIER consequences for the insertion across multiple non-canonical SNTG2 transcripts, including some annotated with nonsense-mediated decay.
verified_claims.notes: VEP-BL-003 and VEP-BL-004 have nonsense_mediated_decay biotype and intronic MODIFIER consequences; others represent alternative transcripts with the same prediction.

verified_claims.text: The insertion breakpoint resides within a repeating genomic region annotated with tandem repeats of type 'trf'.
verified_claims.notes: Ensembl repeat records show tandem repeats of type 'trf' spanning both nominal and breakpoint coordinates.

verified_claims.text: Seven dbVar database entries (esv3656833, nsv3953858, nsv5618433, nsv5961524, nsv6053736, nsv6220675, nsv7862737) represent exact coordinate and type matches for an insertion variant at chromosome 2 coordinate 983,265.
verified_claims.notes: Matches verified. All seven records correspond exactly to an insertion at chromosome 2 coordinate 983265.
